categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance sintered NdFeB (neodymium-iron-boron) permanent magnetic materials. It also produces rubber magnets and other magnetic products, providing related technical services. The main applications of its products include automotive industry, industrial motors, and high-end consumer electronics, focusing on energy-saving and intelligent manufacturing sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies covering the entire production process of sintered NdFeB magnets, including alloy melting, powder preparation, molding, sintering, heat treatment, machining, grain boundary diffusion, and surface treatment. It has proprietary technologies such as grain boundary doping control, atmosphere control, powder surface modification, magnetic field orientation molding, and green, efficient surface protection coatings. The company also focuses on recycling and remanufacturing technologies for waste NdFeB magnets, optimizing rare earth usage and improving magnetic performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers in the automotive industry (including new energy vehicles), industrial motor manufacturers, and high-end consumer electronics companies. The company has established stable supply relationships with domestic and international clients such as German ZF, Schaeffler, Siemens, American Black & Decker, Japanese Makita, Panasonic, and others. Its products are used in electric power steering, new energy vehicle drive motors, energy-saving motors, robotics, wind power generation, 3C and 5G products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production and R&D facilities in Hefei, Baotou, Ningguo, Suzhou, and Shanghai. It also has subsidiaries and sales offices in Germany and Japan, and through acquisitions, it has expanded into the Japanese market. Overseas sales account for about 30% of revenue, with a growing international presence supported by local distributors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the rare earth permanent magnet supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets from rare earth alloy raw materials. It has strategic upstream partnerships, including a joint venture with Northern Rare Earth to secure stable rare earth raw material supply, and downstream it supplies to motor and automotive component manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-performance sintered NdFeB magnet technology with enhanced magnetic properties, thermal stability, and reduced heavy rare earth content. The company invests in green surface protection technologies and recycling of waste magnets to improve resource efficiency. It actively pursues R&D projects on grain boundary diffusion, low rare earth content magnets, and new magnet applications such as robotics and high-power motors. The company also focuses on expanding injection molded magnet business through acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of sintered NdFeB magnets, rubber magnets, and other magnetic products. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to end customers and supplemented by distributors, especially in overseas markets. The company also earns income from related technical services and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer of high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets, recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise. It holds a strong market position with advanced technology platforms and stable relationships with major automotive and industrial motor manufacturers. The industry is competitive with increasing concentration; the company competes by focusing on high-performance products and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.43 billion, a 32.5% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to weakened market demand and lower rare earth raw material prices. Net profit attributable to shareholders was a loss of RMB 42.8 million, compared to a profit in 2022. Total assets were RMB 2.31 billion, down 18.1%, and net assets RMB 1.10 billion, down 7.1%. The company is undergoing capacity expansion and R&D investment to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced technological capabilities in producing high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets with superior magnetic properties, thermal stability, and efficient use of rare earth materials. Its green surface protection and recycling technologies enhance product durability and sustainability. The company’s strong customer relationships, stable rare earth supply, and national innovation platforms differentiate it as a reliable supplier in strategic emerging industries such as new energy vehicles, energy-saving motors, and robotics.
